question: Allarakha Qureshi who is popularly known as Alla Rakha, is an Indian ______ player.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tabla.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Alla Rakha Qureshi** is an Indian **Tabla **player.
 
• He specialised in **Hindustani Classical music** and belongs to **Punjab Gharana**.
 
• He is often seen accompanying Sitar specialist Pandit Ravi Shankar.
 
• Zakir Hussain, a Tabla expert is the son of Qureshi.
 
• He played an **important role in introducing the Tabla to the West**.
 
• He received **Padma Shri in 1977** and **Sangeet Natak Akademi Award in 1982**.

 Kishan Maharaj
 
 
The famous Indian tabla player born in Kabir Chaura, Varanasi, Uttar Pradesh, who belonged to the Benares Gharana is Pandit Kishan Maharaj.

 
A tabla is a pair of twin hand drums from the Indian subcontinent. Since the 18th century, the tabla has been the principal percussion instrument in Hindustani classical music. 

 
Tabla was invented in the first half of the 18th century (about 1738) by a drummer named Amir Khusru.

Ustad Ahmed Jan Khan Thirakwa was an Indian tabla player, commonly considered the pre-eminent soloist among tabla players of the 20th century, and among the most influential percussionists in the history of Indian Classical Music.
